## Badge.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `variant` :: The visual style, from the shared variant axis.
- `size` :: The label height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the badge height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. Pills are the default.
- `dot` :: Draws a small dot in the current ink before the label, for live or status state.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `children` :: The label or the count.
